# Experience

**University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center**

Data Scientist, Bioinformatics \| Sep 2023 -- Present

-   Developed a novel, human-in-the-loop error ontology framework to categorize LLM failure modes in real-world clinical data extraction, enabling collaborative refinement that reduced clinically significant error rates to less than 1%

-   Engineer agentic workflows to transform long EHR histories into structured timelines of key events in the metastatic RCC setting, allowing for robust calculations of progression-free survival (PFS) and adherence to treatment guidelines (NCCN)

-   Maintain MLOps infrastructure on cloud (Azure) and local infrastructure, deploying LLMs, databases, containerized ML APIs with CI/CD pipelines and traceability tools to ensure reproducible model serving and high availability

-   Teach interactive workshops for clinicians and graduate students on AI model bias, failure modes, and interpretation, bridging the gap between technical metrics and clinical applicability

Clinical Data Specialist \| Feb 2020 -- Aug 2023

-   Led cross-functional initiatives for the collection, statistical analysis, and visualization/reporting of data from public databases, leading to a publication that utilized time-to-event statistics to recommend flexible sigmoidoscopy for younger individuals

-   Optimized parallelization in bioinformatics (NGS) processing pipelines using R, Python, AWS, and high-performance computing environments, achieving an 80% reduction in compute time and cost

-   Co-authored, in collaboration with clinicians, multiple publications on colorectal cancer biomarkers, including genomics (driver mutations), gene expression profiles, and microbiome diversity

-   Navigated healthcare data governance, ensuring strict compliance with HIPAA, GCP/HSP, and IRB protocols while coordinating data transfers with external Clinical Research Organizations (CROs)
